parameters.query: SELECT b.id AS brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, COUNT(a.id) AS ad_count FROM public.brands b JOIN public.ads a ON a.brand_id = b.id WHERE a.embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.id, b.name HAVING COUNT(a.id) >= 10 ORDER BY b.id;
SELECT id, embedding_1024 FROM public.ads WHERE brand_id = {{ $json.brand_id }} AND embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL;
